title: Candidate Overview Unified Command Center — Above-The-Fold Resume Workspace, Compact AI Copilot HUD & Friendly Native Mascot
spec: MANDATE: User feedback on DIR-084 overview: 'why am i not able to satisfy myself with this structure and layout. What is missing and why all the options are not in the viewport. Iam now not able to browser bottom part(resumes). Enhance this layout and structure to max best possible with SWOT evidence. Use best approact and friendly cartoons to amke it feel native ai engine.' ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS: 1) Hero banner and 4 Stat cards consume ~500px, triply duplicating data with the right rail. 2) The candidate's primary working asset — their active resumes — is squished into a cut-off bottom sliver that is hard to browse. 3) The cold circular radar feels sterile rather than a friendly native AI engine. ARCHITECTURAL REDESIGN: PHASE 1 - COMPACT AI COPILOT HERO (~90-110px): Sleek horizontal glass HUD featuring a friendly native AI Copilot mascot (illustrated friendly AI robot/avatar with glowing aurora halo: 'PilotAI Copilot Active'), dynamic career insight, and compact quick CTAs (+ New Resume, Explore Jobs, Mock Drill). PHASE 2 - COMPACT METRIC CAPSULE STRIP (~45-55px): 4 horizontal glass KPI capsules in a single tight row (5 Resumes, 69% ATS, 1 Application, Interview Coach Ready). PHASE 3 - PRIMARY CANVAS: ABOVE-THE-FOLD RESUME WORKSPACE: Main Left Column (~68% width) becomes the Primary Resume & Document Workspace! Category pills (All, Resumes, Cover Letters, Portfolios), search/sort, and high-density Resume Cards with thumbnails, ATS badges, and 1-click [Edit], [Tailor AI], [PDF Download] actions immediately browsable in the single viewport. Right Column (~32% width) holds the AI Career Briefing and Live Copilot Quick-Pitch. PHASE 4 - VERIFICATION: Author tests/dir085-overview-workspace-mastery.test.mjs (AC1-AC6), ensure zero whole-window scroll, sub-4s build, clean lint.

plan.summary: DIR-085 recon complete; this is the plan. ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED with file:line evidence. (1) VERTICAL BUDGET: CubaCandidateShell.jsx:473 already bounds the Overview grid at 2xl, and inside it the main column stacks CubaCandidateHero (whose banner is p-4 sm:p-5 with an h1 at text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl and, critically, FOUR full CubaStatCards at CubaCandidateHero.jsx:254-296), then AiCareerBriefing, then DashboardHomepage as children. The four stat cards alone are ~120px each plus gap, so hero + cards + briefing consume roughly 500px of a ~937px 1080p viewport before a single resume is drawn - which is exactly the user's complaint that the resume workspace is a cut-off bottom sliver. (2) TRIPLE DUPLICATION is real and measurable: the hero cards show Active Resumes, Average ATS Score, Job Applications and AI Interview Coach; the right rail (CandidateExecutiveRail.jsx) independently renders an ATS Keyword Strength widget at :129 and an Application Milestones widget at :153; and DashboardHomepage additionally renders a legacy Career Command Center block at :1040-1175 that recomputes calculateAtsScore at :1046 and prints an ATS score at :1101 (it early-returns null for the Cuba shell at :1042, so it is dead weight in the Cuba chrome but the duplication pattern is the same). ATS therefore appears as a headline in TWO places and applications in TWO places. (3) THE COLD RADAR is AtsRadialGauge, imported from StatMicroVisuals.jsx:15 and rendered at CubaCandidateHero.jsx:273 - a bare 56px circle with no character, which is what reads as sterile rather than as a native AI engine. (4) THE WORKSPACE ALREADY EXISTS but is buried: DashboardHomepage already has category pills at :1180-1185, a search box at :1192-1199, per-card ATS badges computed from the REAL calculateAtsScore(document.item)?.qualityScore at :1399, and the card list at :1371+. So the mandate is NOT to invent a workspace but to PROMOTE the existing one above the fold and de-duplicate the metrics. (5) NO MASCOT ASSET EXISTS anywhere under src/assets (I searched every png/svg/webp/gif for mascot/robot/pilot/ai/bot/avatar/illustration and found only trustpilot.png and payment/country icons), so the mascot must be an inline SVG component - no new binary and no new dependency. The design system already ships the right tokens for it: cuba-tokens.css defines --cuba-ai-aurora-a and --cuba-ai-aurora-b, so the glowing aurora halo can be token-driven rather than a hardcoded gradient. PHASE 1 COMPACT AI COPILOT HERO (~90-110px): a new CubaCopilotMascot.jsx renders a friendly inline-SVG AI robot/avatar (rounded head, glowing eyes, antenna, warm smile) inside an aurora halo built from the existing aurora tokens, and a new CopilotHeroHud.jsx renders a single horizontal glass row at py-3: mascot + a PilotAI Copilot Active status pill with a real live indicator + a dynamic career insight line taken from the EXISTING briefingLogic output (never invented) + three compact CTAs (New Resume, Explore Jobs, Mock Drill) wired to the real routes already used elsewhere in the app. It REPLACES the tall gradient banner, so the ~500px hero becomes ~100px. PHASE 2 COMPACT METRIC CAPSULE STRIP (~45-55px): a new CubaMetricCapsule.jsx renders one tight horizontal glass row of four capsules - Resumes, ATS, Applications, Interview Coach Ready - bound to the SAME real values the hero cards used today (count, bestScore from the real ATS calculation, applications, readiness). The four CubaStatCards and the AtsRadialGauge are removed from the hero, so the strip is the ONLY place a headline metric is printed. DE-DUPLICATION RULE, enforced by test: a metric may appear ONCE as a headline (the capsule strip) and at most ONCE as a detail view (the rail), never twice as a headline. The rail keeps its ATS Keyword Strength and Application Milestones widgets as DETAIL views with their existing breakdowns. PHASE 3 ABOVE-THE-FOLD RESUME WORKSPACE: the main left column (~68%, already the 7fr of the existing 7fr/3fr split) leads with the resume workspace instead of the hero: the EXISTING category pills, search and sort, and high-density resume cards with a thumbnail, an ATS badge from the real per-card score, and one-click Edit, Tailor AI and PDF Download actions, all immediately browsable inside the single viewport. The right column (~32%, the existing 3fr) keeps the AI Career Briefing and the Live Copilot Quick-Pitch. The onboarding steps move BELOW the workspace inside the already-internally-scrolling children region so they never push the fold. INVARIANTS: XAMPP-only servers, no detached node/vite/nodemon daemon; frozen src/cv-templates diff 0 (the resume thumbnails and the PDF download path are READ-ONLY consumers); no auth, token, API, DB or RBAC change; ZERO FABRICATED DATA - every number in the hero, the capsules and the cards binds to an existing real source (the same count/bestScore/applications/readiness the hero uses today and the same calculateAtsScore result the cards already compute), and an absent value renders an honest empty state rather than a placeholder figure; preserve every DIR-048/055/072-084 pin and the dir081-dir084 suites; sub-4s build; 0 lint errors. UX STATES: the workspace keeps the DIR-081 four-state contract (ready/loading/empty/error) with a CubaSkeleton card grid while loading and the existing CubaEmptyState when there are no documents; the new HUD and capsules must render honest states rather than zeros when the underlying read has not resolved. RESPONSIVE: 375px stacks HUD, capsules, then the workspace as a single column with the cards at full width; 768px two capsules per row and a two-column card grid; 1080p and 1440p are the single-viewport targets where the whole command centre including the resume cards is above the fold; the DIR-084 viewport lock and its stable scrollbar gutter are preserved. QA: tests/dir085-overview-workspace-mastery.test.mjs with AC1 the compact HUD and capsule strip exist and the four old stat cards plus the radial gauge are gone from the hero; AC2 the workspace is the FIRST block in the main column and the onboarding follows it; AC3 the de-duplication rule holds (no headline metric is printed twice); AC4 zero whole-window scroll (the DIR-084 lock is intact and the Overview grid stays viewport-bounded); AC5 a11y - the mascot is decorative with aria-hidden, the status pill and capsules are labelled, the CTAs keep their accessible names, and contrast stays AA in both themes; AC6 no new dependency, no new binary asset, build under 4s and no fabricated telemetry. A11Y: the mascot is aria-hidden decoration with a text equivalent in the status pill, the capsule strip is a labelled list, the workspace pills keep aria-pressed, the card actions keep their labels, focus-visible is preserved and nothing relies on colour alone. PERFORMANCE: the mascot is inline SVG (no network request, no new dependency), the capsules replace four heavier cards, and the compaction REDUCES paint cost because fewer nodes render above the fold; the build stays under 4s. SEQUENCING AND RISK: mascot and capsules first (new, isolated components), then the hero swap, then the workspace promotion, then the tests. ROLLBACK: each new component is additive and the hero swap is a single edit, so reverting restores today's layout exactly; no schema, API or data surface is touched.
steps: S1 - Create src/components/cuba/CubaCopilotMascot.jsx: a friendly inline-SVG AI robot/avatar (rounded head, glowing eyes, antenna, warm smile) inside an aurora halo driven by the existing --cuba-ai-aurora-a and --cuba-ai-aurora-b tokens, decorative with aria-hidden and no new binary asset or dependency.

S2 - Create src/components/cuba/CubaMetricCapsule.jsx plus the strip: one tight horizontal glass row of four capsules (Resumes, ATS, Applications, Interview Coach Ready) at roughly 45-55px tall, each bound to a real value with a labelled list semantic and an honest empty state when the value is unknown.

S3 - Create src/components/Candidate/CopilotHeroHud.jsx: a single ~90-110px horizontal glass row with the mascot, a PilotAI Copilot Active status pill, a dynamic insight line taken from the existing briefingLogic output, and three compact CTAs (New Resume, Explore Jobs, Mock Drill) wired to the real routes.

S7 - Author tests/dir085-overview-workspace-mastery.test.mjs (AC1-AC6 as described) and register test:dir085 in package.json.
